observation_kind: targeted current official measurement-suitability, pagination and vertical-datum checks; not independent bulk HTTP fetches
rules: The official catalogue states that an API is not available for INSPIRE Index Polygons.
The catalogue reports an average INSPIRE GML file size of 13.66 MB.
The catalogue records the INSPIRE dataset as monthly.
The catalogue records the Open Government Licence for the dataset.
Official guidance warns that BNG-to-WGS84 reprojection may shift some features by up to 15 metres.
Exact current Barnet and Enfield GML asset hrefs remain unavailable through the redirect-looping view.
Current Barnet and Enfield GML bytes and cryptographic hashes remain unavailable.
Current INSPIRE IDs and native-BNG polygon containment for the candidates remain unresolved.
Custom polygon queries use Well-Known Text in the geometry parameter.
Spaces in WKT geometry strings must be percent-encoded.
Custom geometry coordinates use WGS84 EPSG:4326.
Pagination advances offset by the selected limit value.
Responses include next, previous, first and last pagination links.
The API documentation states that there is no batch endpoint for portfolio screening.
Portfolio screening requires one request per property.
The field parameter can restrict the response to required properties.
The official workflow advises polite rate-limiting between property requests.
Exact current title-boundary responses for the three references remain unavailable.
Exact current title-boundary point-intersection responses remain unavailable.
The official WCS guidance lists the DTM 1m minimum statistic as -409.05.
The official WCS guidance lists the DTM 1m maximum statistic as 978.05.
The official WCS guidance lists the DTM 1m mean statistic as 104.63.
The official WCS guidance lists the DTM 1m standard deviation as 107.52.
The guidance states that ArcGIS WCS does not support raster statistics.
The guidance states that WCS rasters in ArcGIS can only be viewed using a stretch render.
ArcGIS users are instructed to enter the WCS base URL only up to the question mark.
The input WCS coverage is expected to populate after entering the base service URL.
The exact DTM coverage identifier remains unavailable because the XML body is not parsed by the current transport.
Exact TQ2892 WCS coverage bytes and candidate pixel values remain unavailable.
OS Terrain 50 contour data uses 10 metre standard contour intervals.
Contour supply includes mean high water, mean low water boundaries and spot heights.
Spot heights are selected from the highest mass point within each closed contour.
A selected spot point is removed when it has the same height as its enclosing contour.
Spot-height z values are rounded to zero decimal places.
Per-tile metadata can record both earliest and latest flying dates.
The metadata identifies Ordnance Datum Newlyn as vertical CRS EPSG:5701.
The national vector-tile supply uses Web Mercator EPSG:3857.
The exact current Terrain50 area=TQ download response remains unavailable.
Current TQ29 archive bytes, file inventory and hashes remain unavailable.
Actual Terrain 50 target-cell values for the candidates remain unavailable.

promotion.reason: Exact HMLR GML/native-BNG containment, Planning candidate readbacks, EA coverage identifier/TQ2892 pixels, OS TQ29 archive/cells and shared-runner revision14 receipts remain absent.
